svg.title: UML packages — feature packages and the layers inside each
svg.desc: Study Buddy Matcher design diagram. Editable source: docs/diagrams/render_diagrams.py. Supplementary text and notation are in docs/diagrams/README.md.

g.text: TEAM A · matching engine and music
TEAM B · platform, identity and AI study tools
TEAM C · requests, groups, admin, notifications, E1 and E2
UML packages — feature packages and the layers inside each
25 packages under com.studybuddy, grouped by owning team; feature packages repeat the same controller → service → domain → repository layering.
✓ Rule 2: only the DTO travels back; the entity never leaves the service
✗ Rule 1: a controller never touches a repository
Packages are organised by feature, so one folder holds everything a marker needs to follow a use case. Shared packages: common, security, user, ai and seed.
The lower package shows the roles a feature package repeats. Open arrows are dependencies; the green path is what a response may carry, the red line a dependency the code forbids.
